Select approved drugs with max_phase_for_ind = 4 for the indication 'chronic kidney disease'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id aliased as indication_curie, mesh_heading aliased as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
